newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC sees Q1 charge not more than $4 mln.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC sees Q1 charge not more than $4 mln.

text.p: AMBAC Inc said it expects to record a first quarter restructuring charge of not more than $4 million following the acquisition of substantially all of the assets of Cadre Financial Services Inc.
AMBAC said it completed the acquisition of Ronkonkoma, N.Y.-based Cadre on December 31, 1996 for about $20 million in cash and stock.
As a result of the acquisition, AMBAC said it has decided to close its Westport, Conn., office and plans to consolidate its financial services businesses in Ronkonkoma.
The consolidation is expected to occur in early 1997 and AMBAC said it anticipates a restructuring charge in the first quarter of 1997 which is not expected to exceed $4 million.
Cadre is a provider of cash management and investment advisory services to local school districts, hospitals and health care organizations and municipalities.
"This acquisition goes a long way toward building the desired critical mass for our municipal investment services business," AMBAC chief executive Phillip Lassiter said.
